notes.title: Version 1.2.2 Changelog
notes.content: [p]✨ [b]Improvements[/b][/p][p]🎥 If the character a player is spectating dies, the camera now switches to a living character[/p][p]🔊 Added gun assembly sound[/p][p][/p][p]🐞 [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p]⚠️ Sometimes items could disappear when switching them in passages and crawl spaces[/p][p]🎮 Playing as Granny with a gamepad, it was impossible to attack with the bat[/p][p]🛏 The camera wouldn’t rotate under the bed when controlled with a gamepad[/p][p]🔨 If Granny killed a character under the bed, the item could fall beneath it and become unreachable[/p][p]🌐 If a player’s game crashed in the lobby, they would still remain visible in the lobby list for others[/p][p]📦 If a player died under the bed, the item could duplicate[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.2.1 Added 3 vs AI game mode
New 3vs1 Mode Released!
notes.content: [p]The long-awaited 3 vs 1 multiplayer mode is now live in Granny: Escape Together with *version v1.2! 🎉[/p][p][/p][p]Previously, the game featured single-player and 2-player co-op vs AI. Now, up to 4 players can join a match, and one of them — the host — takes on the terrifying role of Granny. 👵[/p][p][/p][p]In this new mode, Granny comes equipped with special abilities ⚡️ to hunt down the other players. Master her skills and turn the tide in your favor![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45100588/1a8dd68fc0e7cafa7685e99e08818628b756c61c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Along with this update, we’ve also added a new Steam achievement 🏆 — can you earn it?[/p][p][/p][p]🧠 Hunt your friends.[/p][p]🎭 Outsmart the killer.[/p][p]This is Granny like you've never seen before.[/p][p][/p][p]Try the new mode now and share your feedback! 💬[/p][p]⚠️ This mode is still being balanced and may receive updates soon.[/p][p][/p][p][b]❗️ Important:[/b][/p][p]After updating to v1.2, if the skill keybindings don’t display correctly, please reset your key settings to default in the game menu and restart the game. This will fix the issue.[/p]

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards added!
notes.content:
Great news — Granny: Escape Together now has Steam Trading Cards! 🎉 While playing, you can collect cards, craft badges, unlock new profile backgrounds, and get unique emoticons.

Good luck escaping! 🚪💨

notes.title: Version 1.1.2 Changelog
notes.content:
[b]Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] FPS unlocked
[*] FPS unlocked on SteamDeck
[*] Added brightness setting
[*] Added partition between garage and secret part of house on Extreme mode
[*] Fixed colliders on rugs so loot doesn't fall through them
[*] Added sound of falling grate between floors
[/list]
[b]Bugs fixed:[/b]
[list]

[*] Granny got stuck near a wooden box and did not allow the player to exit
[*] Fixed duplication of inventory objects, tables and floor lamps
[*] When one of the players dies in the locker, the other character can no longer get there
[*] The hatch in the escape room in the mase was disabled
[*] Granny did not attack the player in the locker if he was not the host
[*] Granny cannot go through an open car door
[*] Traps in the labyrinth were visible on Easy mode
[*] Fixed a bug with refueling
[*] Near the screwdriver safe, when it is unscrewed, one of the players glitches by stepping on the lid of the safe
[*] It was possible to jump on the locker from above in the main room
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 Changelog
notes.content:
[b]Fixed a critical bug:[/b]
[list]
[*] Sometimes the escape through the door did not work
[/list]
[b]Bugs fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Granny could be locked in some rooms from which she could not leave
[*] The circle icon could freeze after interacting with quest items
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1 Final Cutscenes!
notes.content:
I am delighted to announce the release of version 1.1 of Granny: Escape Together. This update introduces final cutscenes!

A number of improvements and bug fixes have also been implemented to ensure a smoother gameplay experience. You can see the full list of changes below.

[b]Major Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 4 final cutscenes
[/list]
[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Introduced a new loot spawn preset
[*] Added volume control for jump scares
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] After Grandpa's attack, 2 days were skipped
[*] Field of View (FOV) was reset after a jump scare
[*] Grandpa got stuck near one of the shelters in the maze
[*] Granny couldn't open doors in the room with hooks
[*] Issue when moving the character with a wheel
[*] Installed well handle wasn't visible to the other player
[*] It was possible to lock Granny in the attic and freely explore the house
[*] Could escape through the door without cutting the wire in the electrical box
[*] Loot items were not picked up in places where floors creaked
[*] Charged weapon was unloaded at the start of the day
[*] In multiplayer, if a loaded shotgun was dropped, the other player picking it up couldn't see it was loaded
[*] Granny got stuck in a wooden box where the player was hiding
[*] At the start of a new day, the car trunk closed, and a player who hadn't unlocked it couldn't open it
[*] "Bear Trap" text didn't disappear after escaping from the trap
[/list]

[h3]Thanks everyone for your support![/h3]

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Changelog
notes.content:
[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Items thrown into the well now respawn in the yard.
[*] Added FOV adjustment setting.
[*] Added option to disable jiggle physics.
[*] Adjusted the positioning of the text chat.
[*] Optimized performance of the TV effect.
[*] Improved item spawn locations.
[*] Added support for 3440x1440 resolution.

[/list]
[b]Bugs Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where items disappeared in underground tunnels.
[*] Menu settings sometimes did not save correctly.
[*] The screen occasionally turned dark at the start of the game.
[*] Fixed a bug in the settings menu where changes were not applied on the first attempt.
[*] Adjusted terrain collider.
[*] After being attacked by Grandpa, if the player became a spectator, the chase music would not stop.
[*] Granny could be shot during a jumpscare with the shotgun.
[/list]

notes.title: Granny: Escape Together is Out Now!
notes.content:
[h3]Today marks the official launch of Granny: Escape Together Version 1.0 on Steam, and this day is truly special for me. I’ve poured so much energy into bringing this project to life, and I’m thrilled to finally share it with a wider audience!

A huge thank you to everyone who helped me along the way!

During the beta testing phase, I realized that most of you experienced the game exactly as I envisioned while developing it. It’s incredibly rewarding to see your genuine reactions to playing Granny: Escape Together!

I can’t wait to hear your feedback and ideas so we can continue to improve the game together.

Don’t hesitate to join our Discord server, where an amazing community has already formed! Whether you want to share tips, report a bug, or just chat with other players, we’re always happy to see you there.

Thank you for your support—it means the world to me!

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/aS54dtr7Xt[/h3]

notes.title: Beta Testing Begins on November 8!
notes.content:
[h3]The first stage of beta testing kicks off on November 8. 

This stage will include a 2 vs AI mode, where you can try out the mechanics and share your feedback — it will really help me improve the game further.

Currently, the beta version is only available in English, but I plan to add support for other languages in the full version.

Join the beta test and help make the game even better! I’d also be happy to see you on my [url=https://discord.com/invite/aS54dtr7Xt]Discord server[/url], where you can discuss the game, share your impressions, and provide suggestions.[/h3]

[b][h3][url=https://discord.com/invite/aS54dtr7Xt]Discord Server [/url][/h3][/b]

notes.title: Announcing the Teaser Trailer and Beta Test Preparation!
notes.content:
Hello, dear players!

We’re excited to share our new teaser trailer with you, which tells the backstory of how you ended up in Granny's house.

[previewyoutube=5XQRIsHHd_s;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re also very pleased to see that so many of you are adding our game to your wishlist. This means a lot to us, and we appreciate your support.

Our team is currently hard at work preparing the game for beta testing. Soon, you’ll have the chance to experience the game firsthand.

Be ready for the beta test! We’ll let you know as soon as it’s available.

Stay tuned for updates and join our Discord community to keep up with the latest news and discuss the game with other players.

Thank you for being with us!
